description: Phase 2 parity: in the capture view, Enter with no backlink row focused copies the captured URI (nothing opened); Tab moves keyboard focus onto a backlink row, and Enter on that row opens exactly that backlink's URI through the core opener without copying
requirement: P2-backlink-open (GPUI Phase 2 parity, user decision; Tauri dist/panel.js backlink anchors invoke open_link)
notes: Seeded like backlinks.json: graph-backlinks.json plus capture-subject.json; backlink rows newest first are Gamma Doc, Beta Post, Alpha Paper.

Copy round first (fresh instance): with no ListItem focused, Enter copies (pasteboard = the subject URI, change count up, Copied shown) and opens nothing. This keeps copy-link.json's contract for the capture view with backlinks present.

Open round after a restart: key_until presses Tab until the 'Beta Post' row (the second row, so opening row 1 by default cannot pass) carries the focused flag. focused is the dump's gpui_focus or active_descendant_focus (README 'see' state table), so the row's ListItem node itself must be the focused (or active-descendant) node, not a child button. Exactly one ListItem is focused.

Enter on the focused row opens https://beta.example/two through the core opener (the opened sink holds exactly that one target), does not copy (pasteboard still the nonce, change count unchanged). Copied is not asserted absent afterwards: the panel may close after an open, and an absent check on an empty tree fails by design.
No assertion is made about whether the panel stays open after the open.
